About the model
100,000 Monte Carlo seasons per run on a backtest-weighted ensemble of 6 rating systems and market-implied ratings solved from posted spreads, with per-team home-field advantage, every conference's official tiebreakers and the 12-team playoff bracket. Run settings: margin SD 15.25 · HFA P4 2.8/G5 2.07 · shock SD 5.75 · 1149 Kalshi markets · Δwk vs Sep 8 · audit ✓ 5, 10 · Ratings are on the SP+ points scale: the gap between two teams is the expected margin on a neutral field.
Sources & weightsDokter Entropy 27%TeamRankings 19%Market 17%FPI 11%Sagarin 9%SP+ 9%Pear 9%
What do these columns mean?
Rtgteam strength in points; the gap between two teams is the expected margin on a neutral field
Δwkrating change since the Sep 8 run (about a week ago)
W-L / CW-Lactual overall and conference records
Nextthe next game and our win chance
SOSaverage opponent rating, played and to come (higher = harder)
xW / xCWexpected wins and expected conference wins
CCG%chance to reach the conference title game
Conf%chance to win the conference
CFP%chance to make the 12-team playoff
Natty%chance to win the national title
Tipstap a team for its card; tap a header to sort; small superscripts are ranks

eROIexpected return on the bet: edge divided by price
Best Betstight, well-traded books with 25%+ eROI and at least 3¢ of edge after fees; Liquid = the busiest books
Advanced viewthe full book (bid, ask, spread, volume) and the maker numbers, resting one cent inside the book
